record.title: Turning a lawn into a meadow
record.why: "Meadows are not low-maintenance" makes the case for and against, but never follows up with how to actually do it, which is the obvious next question for anyone it persuaded.
record.notes: This is a practical companion to the opinion piece and should link back to it. Cover stripping or reducing fertility, sowing yellow rattle (glossed as a semi-parasitic annual that weakens the grasses), timing for a northern autumn, and the annual cut and lift. Be honest that the first two years look disappointing. [Need: the studio's preferred method and seed sources, and a project to point to if there is one.]
